# DAAD-X

Explainable driver maneuver data extending DAAD with gaze-aligned and vehicle-context explanations.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Synchronized driver and surrounding-road clips with gaze observations before a maneuver.

**Output / label:** The future maneuver and observer-annotated gaze/vehicle explanation categories.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Skyrmion/DAAD-X)

**Example evidence:** [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Skyrmion/DAAD-X), [code](https://github.com/Mukil07/Explainable-Driver-Intention-Prediction), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09200)

## Intention in this dataset

Observed future maneuvers proxy driver intention; human-authored gaze and ego explanations express attributed reasons, not driver self-reports.

**Relevance:** `explicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2025

**Domains:** driver_behavior  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation, intention_reasoning  
**Modalities:** rgb, gaze, text  
**Formats:** video, text, structured_annotation

## Relevant annotations

| Target ID | Meaning | Provenance | Scope | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maneuver` | Seven maneuver labels including straight, stop, turns, lane changes and U-turn. | behavior_derived | Maneuver clips | [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09200), [code](https://github.com/Mukil07/Explainable-Driver-Intention-Prediction) |
| `ego_explanation` | Seventeen ego-vehicle explanation categories; multi-label. | observer_judgment | Gaze-aligned selected clips | [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09200) |
| `gaze_explanation` | Fifteen gaze explanation categories; single-label. | observer_judgment | Gaze-aligned selected clips | [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09200) |

## Limits and notes

The paper uses 1,568 gaze-aligned clips. The repository also lists 158 clips without synchronized gaze; those counts describe different subsets.
